prompts.title: 超现实主义自然回收科技海报
prompts.description: 一个用于创作时尚、超现实海报的提示，海报内容为一件被大自然回收的科技产品（iPhone Air），郁郁葱葱的藤蔓和鲜花缠绕其上，背景是戏剧性的高山草甸和山脉，置于电影般的灯光之下。
prompts.content: Create a stylish hyperrealistic poster featuring a vibrant, scene with soft lighting and saturated colors. The main subject is a [{argument name="device" default="I phone air"} ] adorned with the [{argument name="logo" default="iphone"}] logo and name, positioned centrally in a blooming alpine meadow. Lush vines and delicate morning glory flowers intricately wrap around the object, as if nature is reclaiming it. The background showcases snow-capped mountains under a cinematic sky. Use a dynamic angle with a shallow depth of field, focusing sharply on the object while blending soft mist and atmospheric haze. The lighting should be sunny contrasting against cool mountain shadows. The color palette combines rich greens, deep blues, and warm tones. Render the scene in a photorealistic DSLR style, with polished details and a cinematic vignette for a high-end editorial look.
prompts.translatedContent: 创作一张时尚的超写实海报，描绘一个充满活力的场景，柔和的光线和饱和的色彩交织。主体是一个 [{argument name="device" default="I phone air"}]，上面装饰着 [{argument name="logo" default="iphone"}] 的标志和名称，它被放置在盛开的高山草甸中央。郁郁葱葱的藤蔓和精致的牵牛花缠绕在物体周围，仿佛大自然正在将其收回。背景是电影般的天空下的雪山。使用动态角度和浅景深，锐利地聚焦于物体，同时融入柔和的薄雾和大气霾。光线应是阳光明媚，与凉爽的山影形成对比。调色板结合了浓郁的绿色、深蓝色和暖色调。以逼真的单反风格渲染场景，细节精致，并带有电影般的晕影，营造出高端的编辑效果。

prompts.content: Create an ultra-realistic image in the horror style of the 90s. The model (man with brown hair, faithful to the provided photo) is sitting next to Ghostface in a McDonald's restaurant with a classic 90s look. Both are eating hamburgers, illuminated by soft, warm lighting in a nostalgic, retro atmosphere. Model's outfit: gray oversized T-shirt and faded wide jeans. Aesthetics: subtle film grain, cinematic tone, strong realism, and nostalgic charm. Background: slightly blurred McDonald's interior with warm tones and ambient light that evokes the 1990s era. Don't change the face. (Use the attached image)

prompts.title: iPhone 美学提示词生成器框架
prompts.description: 这是一个元提示或系统指令，旨在引导大型语言模型（如 Nano Banana 2）生成高度具体、结构化的 JSON 提示，用于创建超逼真的 AI 影响者，模拟 iPhone Pro Max 摄像头的光学特性和美学（例如，24mm 焦距、深度融合、计算散景）。用户必须提供场景描述才能触发 JSON 输出。
prompts.content:
<role>
You're specialized in computational photography, specifically the optical characteristics of the iPhone 16/17 Pro Max sensor system. You translate human concepts into mathematically precise image generation prompts.
</role>

<cognitive_framework>
<principle name="Context Hunger">
If the user provides a vague concept (e.g., "girl at a cafe"), you must explicitly invent the missing environmental, lighting, and styling details to ensure a complete image.
</principle>
<principle name="The iPhone Aesthetic">
All outputs must strictly simulate high-end mobile photography.
- Focal Lengths: 24mm (Main), 13mm (Ultra Wide), or 77mm (Telephoto).
- Characteristics: "Apple ProRAW" color science, sharp details (Deep Fusion), computational bokeh (Portrait Mode), and Smart HDR dynamic range.
- Avoid: Anamorphic lens flares, exaggerated "cinema" bokeh, or vintage film grain (unless specified as a filter).
</principle>
<principle name="Imperfection is Realism">
To achieve "ultra-realism," you must inject terms describing unpolished reality: digital noise (not film grain), skin texture, slightly blown-out highlights (common in mobile), and natural "snapshot" framing.
</principle>
<principle name="JSON Precision">
Your output is a strict JSON object designed for programmatic use.
</principle>
</cognitive_framework>

<visual_analysis_reference>
The "Influencer Aesthetic" is defined by:
- Vibe: "Plandid" (planned candid), effortlessness, aspirational lifestyle.
- Lighting: Natural window light, golden hour, or "flash photography" (hard flash) for night shots.
- Framing: Vertical (9:16) native mobile aspect ratio, often selfies or point-of-view (POV).
</visual_analysis_reference>

<instructions>
1. Analyze the user's request for subject and mood.
2. Enrich the request using "iPhone Photography" constraints.
3. Format the output strictly as a JSON object with the following schema.
</instructions>

<json_schema>
{
  "meta_data": {
    "style": "iPhone Pro Max Photography",
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16"
  },
  "prompt_components": {
    "subject": "Detailed description of person, styling, pose (mirror selfie, 0.5x angle, etc.)",
    "environment": "Detailed background, location, social setting",
    "lighting": "Smart HDR lighting, natural source, or direct flash",
    "camera_gear": "iPhone 16 Pro Max, Main Camera 24mm f/1.78, or Ultra Wide 13mm",
    "processing": "Apple ProRAW, Deep Fusion, Shot on iPhone",
    "imperfections": "Digital noise, motion blur, authentic skin texture, screen reflection (if mirror)"
  },
  "full_prompt_string": "The combined, comma-separated string optimized for realistic mobile generation",
  "negative_prompt": "Standard negatives + 'professional camera, DSLR, bokeh balls, anamorphic, cinema lighting, studio lighting'"
}
</json_schema>

<task>
Await user description of the scene. Generate the JSON output immediately.
</task>

prompts.title: Google Pixel 美学人像
prompts.description: 一个高度具体的提示，使用“PersonaFusion-vX.03 协议”生成一张超逼真、超清晰的肖像，且与参考图像相比，面部零改动。美学效果模仿 Google Pixel 8 拍摄的照片，强调玫瑰色妆容、“玻璃肌”质感、柔和的空气刘海和自然的窗边日光。
prompts.content:
Initiate PersonaFusion-vX.03 protocol: Use the exact facial identity taken from the attached reference image (or from the user’s provided face) with zero alteration.
[SCENE]: A brightly lit indoor setting, captured in a close-up, head-and-shoulders composition. The subtly textured background features dimly visible, dark, minimalist elements, with no discernible bokeh or background blur, ensuring the entire frame is in sharp focus.
[SUBJECT]: A subject with a fair complexion and rosy undertone, posed with a gentle smile, looking directly at the camera. Their hair features soft curtain bangs framing the face, with the main body styled in soft mermaid waves and wispy, damp-looking strands falling around the face and shoulders, held back partially by a delicate pink ribbon near the ear. Makeup includes prominent rosy pink blush extending across the cheeks and bridge of the nose, glossy pink lips, defined eyelashes with a subtle wing eyeliner, and shimmering eyeshadow. The subject wears delicate, multi-layered pink beaded necklaces with various charms including hearts and small bows, and elegant pearl and gold stud earrings. Their skin is flawless and luminous, featuring a 'glass skin' texture with intense, dewy highlights on the bridge and tip of the nose.
[LIGHTING]: Natural window daylight illuminates the scene with a slightly warm white balance and soft highlight rolloff. Gentle warm window light enhancing natural blush tones reflects subtly on the skin.
[AESTHETIC]: A hyper-realistic, ultra-sharp photograph taken on a modern smartphone, characterized by its digital clarity, specifically a Google Pixel 8. The entire scene is in sharp focus, showcasing realistic digital textures with discernible skin pores and crisp details on accessories. Minimal HDR flattening and preserved blush saturation are evident, resulting in true-to-life, vibrant colors. ar 4:5
prompts.translatedContent:
启动 PersonaFusion-vX.03 协议：使用附件参考图像（或用户提供的面部）中的确切面部身份，零改动。
[场景]：明亮的室内环境，特写镜头，构图为头部和肩膀。背景纹理细微，隐约可见深色、极简主义元素，没有明显的焦外虚化或背景模糊，确保整个画面都清晰对焦。
[主体]：一位肤色白皙、带有玫瑰色调的主体，面带微笑，直视镜头。她的头发是柔和的法式刘海，主发型是柔软的美人鱼波浪，脸部和肩膀周围散落着纤细、湿润的发丝，耳边用一根精致的粉色丝带部分固定。妆容包括：颧骨和鼻梁上明显的玫瑰粉色腮红，亮粉色唇妆，根根分明的睫毛和精致的眼线，以及闪亮的眼影。主体佩戴着精致的多层粉色珠串项链，上面有心形和小蝴蝶结等各种吊坠，以及优雅的珍珠和金色耳钉。她的皮肤完美无瑕，光彩照人，呈现出“玻璃肌”质感，鼻梁和鼻尖有强烈的水润高光。
[光线]：自然窗户日光照亮场景，白平衡略偏暖，高光柔和过渡。柔和温暖的窗户光线增强了自然的腮红，并在皮肤上 subtly 反射。
[美学]：一张由现代智能手机（具体为 Google Pixel 8）拍摄的超现实、超清晰照片，特点是其数字清晰度。整个场景都清晰对焦，展现出逼真的数字纹理，皮肤毛孔清晰可见，配饰细节锐利。HDR 扁平化程度最低，腮红饱和度得以保留，呈现出真实生动、色彩鲜艳的效果。宽高比 4:5。

prompts.description: 一个高度详细、复杂的提示，用于生成具有电影科幻美学的超现实、特写肖像。“梦想家”被描绘在一个低温花卉档案库中，其天然头发被一圈发光的冰冻结晶牡丹光环所取代，强调纹理保真度、特定的灯光效果（青色和洋红色）和高端微距摄影设置。

prompts.title: 金色时段海洋缪斯旅行照片
prompts.description: 生成一张旅行与生活方式图片的提示词，内容为一位时尚年轻女性在黄金时段坐在船上。提示词详细描述了她身穿红色比基尼上衣、花卉图案泳裤和围巾，强调了温暖的光线、深蓝色海洋和奢华的夏日度假氛围。
